# vendor/

- `edit-kit/`: **Edit Kit** by Sahil Sharma (MIT) with bundled open-source skills from HyperFrames (HeyGen, Apache 2.0), ReelMimic, webgl-animation-skills, claude-code-video-toolkit, video-shotcraft, vox-director, painted-animation and Anthropic's frontend-design. Their licences are kept in `edit-kit/LICENSE`, `edit-kit/CREDITS.md` and `edit-kit/licenses/`. It is copied unchanged as reference material: TSVG doesn't run it. `edit-kit-catalog/` maps every video it can make to what TSVG can do (see the gallery's Edit Kit page).
- `Edit-Kit.zip`: the original archive (gitignored; GitHub's file-size limit is 100 MB).
